nodes.label: Bug Triage Pipeline (assess → fix → test)
nodes.rationale: Bug lifecycle: assessment.md (triage + remediation proposal, read-only) → fix.md (apply remediation, record changes) → test.md (validate, no source modifications). Each stage treats the previous artifact as the contract.

nodes.label: Assessment Pipeline (intake → research → define → shape → decide)
nodes.norm_label: assessment pipeline (intake → research → define → shape → decide)
nodes.rationale: Five-stage assessment that converts a raw idea into a go/clarify/kill verdict. Each stage has a single responsibility; killing ideas at decide is treated as success. Only go verdicts hand off to /speckit.specify.

nodes.label: Spec Quality Checklist (requirements.md)
nodes.rationale: Built-in reviewer-owned checklist at FEATURE_DIR/checklists/requirements.md maintained by /speckit.specify and /speckit.clarify. Distinct from custom checklists generated by /speckit.checklist. Marker state is read-only gate for /speckit.implement.

nodes.label: Append-Only Convergence Contract
nodes.rationale: Converge NEVER modifies spec.md, plan.md, or rewrites tasks.md. Only appends a new '## Phase N: Convergence' section with zero-padded T{M+1:03d} IDs, ordered CRITICAL/HIGH first. On zero findings, tasks.md is left byte-for-byte unchanged.

nodes.label: Unit Tests for English (Checklist Philosophy)
nodes.rationale: Checklists validate requirements QUALITY (completeness, clarity, consistency, measurability, coverage, edge cases), never implementation behavior. Required patterns: 'Are [requirement type] defined...?' / 'Is [vague term] quantified...?'. Prohibited: 'Verify', 'Test', 'Confirm' + system behavior.

nodes.label: Constitution Authority Principle
nodes.rationale: Project constitution (.specify/memory/constitution.md) is non-negotiable within analyze/converge scope. Constitution conflicts are automatically CRITICAL and require spec/plan/tasks adjustment, never dilution of the principle. Unfilled templates are skipped gracefully.

nodes.label: Extension Hooks Protocol
nodes.rationale: Reads .specify/extensions.yml; honors hooks.before_<cmd> and hooks.after_<cmd>. Filters out hooks where enabled=false; does not interpret hook condition expressions (deferred to HookExecutor). Mandatory hooks (optional:false) MUST be invoked; optional hooks surfaced with a prompt. No-silent-skip on parse errors.

nodes.label: Handoff Metadata in YAML Frontmatter
nodes.rationale: Frontmatter 'handoffs:' list declares next-stage commands (label, agent, prompt, optional send:true). Used by /speckit.specify → speckit.plan/clarify, /speckit.plan → speckit.tasks/checklist, /speckit.tasks → speckit.analyze/implement.

nodes.label: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] Marker Convention
nodes.rationale: Hard cap of 3 [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers per spec; prioritized by scope > security/privacy > UX > technical. Used as honest placeholder for guesses that have multiple reasonable interpretations with different implications.

nodes.label: Path Safety / Ancestor Symlink Resolution
nodes.rationale: Before any read/write, resolves the real (symlink-stripped) path of every ancestor (e.g. .specify, .specify/assessments/<slug>) and refuses if any component is a symlink or escapes the project root. Blocks a cloned or crafted project from redirecting I/O outside the repo.

nodes.label: Progressive Disclosure of Artifacts
nodes.rationale: Analyze/converge/clarify load only minimal necessary sections (e.g. Functional Requirements, Success Criteria from spec; Architecture/Phases from plan) instead of dumping raw artifacts. Caps analyze output at 50 findings rows.

nodes.label: Severity Heuristic Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Four-tier heuristic shared across analyze and converge: CRITICAL (constitution MUST violation, blocking baseline), HIGH (duplicate/conflicting req, ambiguous NFR, untestable acceptance), MEDIUM (terminology drift, missing NFR coverage), LOW (style/minor redundancy).

nodes.label: Slug Normalization & Safety
nodes.rationale: Normalize slugs to lowercase + [a-z0-9-] only (strip '.', '/', '\'); collapse repeated '-'; reject empty results. Guarantees the constructed ASSESS_DIR cannot escape its parent directory.

nodes.label: Spec Kit Template Resolution Stack
nodes.rationale: Project overrides compose with preset layers and extension layers above a core template fallback. Resolved at command time via .specify/scripts/powershell/resolve-template.ps1. Spec/plan/constitution/tasks templates resolved independently.

nodes.label: URL Trust Policy
nodes.rationale: Classifies hosts/schemes as refuse-outright (loopback, RFC1918, metadata endpoints) vs allowlisted public sources vs unrecognized. Defeats DNS rebinding by requiring connection-pinning to validated public addresses.

nodes.label: User-Story-Organized Task Phases
nodes.rationale: Tasks organized by user story (P1/P2/P3 from spec.md) with strict checklist format: '- [ ] [TaskID] [P?] [Story?] Description with file path'. Phase structure: Setup → Foundational → User Stories → Polish. Independent test criteria per story.

nodes.label: Decision Verdict Taxonomy
nodes.rationale: Three verdicts: 'go' (problem validity adequate+, evidence strength adequate+, concept option recommended); 'needs-clarification' (promising but blocked on unknowns — name the stage to revisit); 'kill' (decisive reason stated plainly). Weak/unknown evidence forbids a go.

nodes.label: DEPENDS_ON parent-child flag dependency rule
nodes.rationale: When a parent flag is false, child flags are not exercised in that fixture (FR-004). Hand-curated per fixture rather than automated enforcement; archetype rejects unknown properties as a safety net.

nodes.label: LLM temperature=0 determinism contract
nodes.rationale: External inference script MUST set temperature=0 (and recommended top_p=0) to satisfy FR-012 byte-equivalence across repeated invocations; mechanism does not compensate for non-deterministic inference.

nodes.label: Cache key SHA-256 derivation
nodes.rationale: SHA-256 of (textualDescription + \u0000 + canonicalJSONContract). The null byte separator prevents collisions where one input's bytes are a prefix of another's. Combined with sorted-key canonicalization this guarantees stable cache keys regardless of field ordering.

nodes.label: Contract > LLM > Default precedence rule
nodes.rationale: Contract value wins over LLM inference; LLM fills in keys the contract does not address; defaults fill the rest; LLM-inferred keys absent from the contract are discarded (FR-009). Prevents inferred values from silently overriding declared decisions.

nodes.label: Implementation drift: Orchestrator inlined into single file (D1/D2/D3)
nodes.norm_label: implementation drift: orchestrator inlined into single file (d1/d2/d3)
nodes.rationale: gmaven:execute 2.1.1 bundles Groovy 2.4.9 and cannot load sibling Groovy 4 classes; Orchestrator inlines all 6 sibling behaviors as private methods. Orchestrator also NOT wired into pom.xml as a build step (would fail with code 2 on every mvn clean install because the archetype build has no description/contract).

nodes.label: External LLM inference delegation
nodes.rationale: Shell out to operator-supplied $EDA_LLM_INFERENCE_BIN to keep Groovy code free of HTTP-client/SDK dependencies; lets operator reuse existing LLM tooling. FR-012 byte-equivalence enforced via temperature=0 contract on the script.

nodes.label: Sorted-key JSON canonicalization (no JCS library)
nodes.rationale: Use groovy-json to recursively sort object keys before serialization; SHA-256 via JDK MessageDigest. Rejected RFC 8785 (JCS) library to avoid new dependency; rejected raw JsonOutput (unstable cache keys) and hashCode() (non-portable).

nodes.label: XInclude flag catalog extraction
nodes.rationale: Read target/classes/META-INF/maven/archetype-metadata.xml (already XInclude-merged by xml-maven-plugin:1.2.1 + identity.xsl); parse with groovy-xml. Reject hardcoded flag list (FR-013) to avoid drift between bash prompt scripts and catalog.

nodes.label: FR-018: Empty defaultValue build-time error
nodes.rationale: Any requiredProperty with empty defaultValue is a build-time catalog error; mechanism exits with code 4 and names the offending flag before any inference or contract processing. Fail-loud replaces bash legacy's silent prompting.

nodes.label: Byte-equivalence acceptance criterion
nodes.rationale: The generated archetype-post-generate.groovy MUST be byte-equivalent to the bash_script/create_archetype_post_generate.sh output. Verified via diff returning empty and SHA-256 hash equality. No tolerance for divergence.

nodes.label: Groovy 4.0.28 classpath decision
nodes.rationale: Declare org.apache.groovy:groovy:4.0.28 + groovy-json:4.0.28 as plugin <dependencies> to add to gmaven 2.1.1 classpath; no initial exclusion of gmaven-adapter-impl because conflict risk is low. Empirically the override did not apply (gmaven 2.1.1 bundles Groovy 2.4.9) but composer ran successfully with the bundled version.

nodes.label: process-resources Maven phase decision
nodes.rationale: Phase chosen because it follows generate-resources (where xml-maven-plugin:transform runs) and precedes package/integration-test; mirrors precedent set by xml-maven-plugin and avoids mixing two transformers in the same phase.
